# Tool catalog

Every factory in the tool-factory registry, read from the registry itself rather
than maintained by hand. `createTools()` is a walk over exactly this list, so if a
tool is here it is reachable, and if it is not here nothing will build it.

This is the *registered* set, not the set any one agent sees: a factory returns
`[]` when its config gate is off or unconfigured, and an agent's `tools:` allowlist
narrows further.

Registered factories: **24** · meta-tools always injected: **8**

## No default for the config gate

Their config gate has no entry in `DEFAULT_CONFIG`, so the tool exists but is
invisible in a fresh `config.yaml` — you can only turn it on if you already know
the key. That is the right shape for an optional integration with credentials to
supply, and the wrong shape for anything else; the list is here to be reviewed,
not assumed broken.

| Tool | Gate |
| --- | --- |
| `browser` | `tools.browser` |
| `browser_mediator` | `tools.browser_mediator` |
| `claude_code` | `tools.claude_code` |
| `coding_agent` | `tools.coding_agent` |
| `md_to_pdf` | `tools.md_to_pdf` |
| `notify_owner` | `tools.notify_owner` |

## Meta-tools

Injected by `createMetaTools()` on every agent, outside the registry and outside
the `tools` config block. They are the reason an agent always has a way to
delegate, check a task, and read its own memory.

- `delegate`
- `task_status`
- `admin`
- `memory`
- `ask_user`
- `run_workflow`
- `resource_admin`
- `load_skill`
